name: todo-list-js
description: Lista didática local e edição web com Express e PostgreSQL

scripts.dev:docker: docker compose --env-file .env.example -f docker-compose.web.yml --profile aplicacao up app-web
scripts.test:integration:docker: docker compose -p todo-list-integration --env-file .env.example -f docker-compose.web.yml --profile testes run --rm testes-api
scripts.test:e2e:web: docker compose -p todo-list-web-e2e --env-file .env.example -f docker-compose.web.yml --profile e2e-web run --build --rm playwright-web
scripts.test:e2e:headed: docker compose run --rm --service-ports playwright npx playwright test --project=chromium --headed
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
